fields.label: What must the proposed specification change?

risks.mitigation: The assessor should cite the committed oakridge-dbos tests as code evidence, label the builder output accurately as the observation-suite test_evidence, and avoid claiming that output directly executed T1.
risks.description: The mandated command runs only the observation workspace, so its output will not directly exercise T1 even though committed Oakridge tests cover default-off parsing and ordered delivery.

risks.mitigation: The builder must record the detached commit it actually inspects as head_sha; the assessor must assess that exact head_sha, as the specification requires.
risks.description: The target branch name can move between analysis and execution.

risks.mitigation: Run the specified command once, preserve its real counts and output, and report an unrun or failed test as a known issue without inventing results.
risks.description: The observation suite may depend on services unavailable in the isolated environment.

body.summary: The audit is ready to plan as exactly one cohort named audit with T1 and T2. The local base is b442f99ccdd68699a346ee55dd9fbe27bc3335d0 and the locally available PR head is c7e326b7d1c7b03e8d051a079967d496b07e541f. The target code exposes concrete evidence for default-off launch grading, ordered config delivery, exact-claim fencing, and transactional completion-plus-observation. No operator decision or code change is needed; the later builder should perform only the authorized detached checkout, dependency preparation if needed, one specified observation test run, and publication of the existing PR.

findings.description: T1 is directly auditable: oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:21-41 defaults an omitted grading_enabled to false, rejects a non-boolean value, and returns the named RunConfig; oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-48 places the committed config beside the launched input. Committed tests at oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83 and oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts:50-65 cover the default and mapped forms.

The ordered-delivery part of T1 spans more than the two paths named in the task: oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation.ts:13-20 reads the committed config while constructing each cursor-ordered delivery, and oakridge-dbos/src/storage/read-store.ts:467-476 distinguishes none, committed, and malformed config. The end-to-end replay assertion is present at oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-209. This is an assessment qualification, not missing implementation.

T2 exact-claim fencing is concretely defined at observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:194-228: it locks the execution row first, then rechecks status, owner, attempt number, and database-time lease validity, and fences the authoritative update again. Stale, expired, reclaimed, and lock-wait cases are exercised at observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:304-357.

T2 transactional completion is directly auditable at observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:267-292, where the fenced execution update, provider-attempt update, and grade_observation insert share one withTenant transaction. observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:231-244 verifies both rollback when the observation insert is refused and joint success.

The execution protocol is fully authorized and needs no further operator choice: the builder is told to detach at the named head, avoid all code/remote mutations, run bun run --filter observation test exactly once, report real output, and publish PR #791; the assessor is told to use the same commit and provide per-task file and test/output evidence. The target package declares that exact workspace test script at observation/package.json:6-10.

requirements.description: Produce exactly one cohort named audit with exactly two tasks, T1 and T2, and keep downstream artifacts short.
Audit that launch config carries grading_enabled, defaults it off when omitted, and delivers it with the ordered launch input.
Audit that evaluation settlement is fenced to the exact current claim and completion appends its observation atomically.

From the PR base, detach at origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2, inspect without edits or remote mutations, install only if needed, run the observation workspace tests once, publish actual build_result data, and publish existing PR #791.
Assess the builder head_sha unchanged, give at least one finding per task with path:start-end code evidence and separate test/output evidence, and report the builder run as test_evidence.
